No stray provider-key client constructions remain outside `ai_scientist/llm.py`. Migration is complete and verified.

## Summary

**Migrated to Router:**
- **`ai_scientist/llm.py`** (the central LLM abstraction): `create_client` now builds a single Router-backed client per request — `openai.OpenAI(base_url=..., api_key=RAMP_ROUTER_API_KEY)` for everything (OpenAI, DeepSeek, OpenRouter/Llama, Gemini — previously four separate provider clients with separate provider keys), using Router's Responses API. Claude models (detected by `"claude" in model`, same heuristic the original code already used) keep using the Anthropic SDK's native Messages shape — per the migration rules, a codebase already on the Anthropic API can stay on Router's Messages-compatible surface — just repointed at Router's base URL/key. Collapsed all the Chat-Completions branches (gpt/o1/o3/llama/deepseek/deepseek-reasoner/gemini) into one Responses-API branch (`messages`→`input`, system→`instructions`, `max_tokens`/`max_completion_tokens`→`max_output_tokens`, reading `response.output_text`). `get_batch_responses_from_llm`'s old `n=` trick (GPT/Llama only) has no Responses equivalent, so all models now use the sequential-sampling loop that was already the fallback path for other models — this preserves the ensembling semantics exactly, just via N calls instead of one call with `n=`.
- Removed hardcoded model-name lists/defaults (`AVAILABLE_LLMS`, `"gpt-4o-2024-05-13"`, `"claude-3-5-sonnet-..."`, etc.) — these were invented/stale provider model names, invalid now that Router's catalog is account-specific. Replaced with `AI_SCIENTIST_MODEL` / `AI_SCIENTIST_REVIEW_MODEL` env vars, read in `generate_ideas.py`, `perform_writeup.py`, `launch_scientist.py`, `experimental/launch_oe_scientist.py`, `review_iclr_bench/iclr_analysis.py`.
- Removed the four direct `openai.OpenAI()` constructions with hardcoded models in `launch_scientist.py` and `experimental/launch_oe_scientist.py` (used for the paper-review step) — now go through `create_client`.
- `review_iclr_bench/iclr_analysis.py` had its own duplicated, drifted copy of the old provider-dispatch logic (including a latent `args.model` vs `model` bug) — replaced with a single call to `ai_scientist.llm.create_client`.
- Dropped the dead `google-generativeai` import/dependency (Gemini was already routed through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, never through that SDK).
- Updated `README.md`'s key/model documentation accordingly.

**Issues found only by testing against the Router simulator** (not visible from static reading):
- The installed `anthropic` SDK version here no longer accepts `temperature` as a typed `messages.create` kwarg — now passed via `extra_body`.
- The Anthropic SDK appends `/v1/messages` itself (unlike the OpenAI SDK), so it needs the base URL *without* the trailing `/v1` that `RAMP_ROUTER_BASE_URL` carries — handled via a separate `ROUTER_ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`.
- Router's model catalog is opaque and many current models reject `temperature` with no naming pattern to detect in advance (confirmed live against both an OpenAI- and an Anthropic-family model). Rather than guess from model-name substrings, both branches now catch that specific 400 and retry once without `temperature`.

**Not migrated — flagged, not guessed:**
- The experiment-coding and LaTeX-writeup steps (`aider.coders.Coder` / `aider.models.Model`, used in `launch_scientist.py`, `experimental/launch_oe_scientist.py`, `ai_scientist/perform_writeup.py`) run through aider's own LiteLLM-based client, entirely separate from `ai_scientist/llm.py`. Router has no Chat Completions surface, and aider doesn't speak the Responses API, so it can't be pointed at Router without forking/patching aider itself — out of scope for a transport-only migration. These call sites still require a provider API key (`OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, or `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, depending on the model string passed to aider), which I left in place and d
